thread:
oncall-bot: Pager P1: Increased 500s and p99 latency for /v1/generate (Dedicated eu-central-1). SLOs at risk. Paging @arjun-oncall and @emma-sre.

arjun-oncall: Got it. I'm oncall. Quick ask: are we seeing config changes or a traffic spike?

emma-sre: Early signal looks like a TTL rollback that went out in last config push. Several hosts got `kv.default_ttl=0` from recent apply (config id cfg-778). Disk IO and eviction counts spiked.

sam-runtime: Confirmed. I can push immediate temporary rollback to previous config (cfg-777) to stop evictions. Would like deploy approval for emergency patch.

arjun-oncall: Do it. Also start an emergency canary to one host first. Monitor error-rate and p95.

sam-runtime: Rolling rollback canary to host-11 now: `opsctl config apply --pool eu-central-1 --from cfg-777 --to-host host-11`

deploy-bot: Emergency rollout started by sam-runtime 1930123456-canary. Host host-11.

sam-runtime: Canary stable for 3m. Error-rate down from 62% -> 4% on canary host. Rolling to remaining hosts.

alerts-bot: Alert update: /v1/generate errors (eu-central-1) decreasing. Current cluster average error-rate 9%. Some long-lived connections still experience 429s.

emma-sre: Short-term mitigation successful. Root cause: config service accepted TTL=0 without validation. Patch pushed by ops pipeline without schema check.

darun-not-a-person: (system note) — placeholder

arjun-oncall: Customer impact: 8 Dedicated customers saw degraded throughput; 1 enterprise customer (MediCo, tenant medi-88) had failed production jobs. Recommend CSM reach-out and incident notification.

dana-product: I'll draft a short comms for affected customers. Need timeline and RCA summary. Can someone open a postmortem ticket?

arjun-oncall: Created ticket INC-9999. Scheduling: propose 45m postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Tagging SRE, Runtime, Product, and CSMs.

emma-sre: Action items being added to INC-9999:
- INC-9999-01: Add server-side validation to config service to block ttl<=0 (owner: sam-runtime)  estimate: 2d.
- INC-9999-02: Add deploy-time gate that warns and requires manual approval for risky config patches (owner: emma-sre)  estimate: 1d.
- INC-9999-03: Synthetic test that exercises KV eviction at scale and alerts on eviction-thrash (owner: arjun-oncall)  estimate: 3d.
- INC-9999-04: Customer comms + regulatory note for MediCo (owner: ilana-csm)  estimate: 4h.
- INC-9999-05: Backfill metrics to split errors by connection age, add alert on 5xx spike for dedicated pools (owner: emma-sre)  estimate: 1d.

sam-runtime: I'll take INC-9999-01. Plan: add JSON schema for configs, reject ttl values <= 0, add unit tests + e2e. PR will reference ops-ci job. ETA 48h.

emma-sre: I'll pick INC-9999-02 and INC-9999-05. For the gate, propose a lightweight preflight that compares changed keys against a denylist and requires `--force` with human ack. For metrics, need a dashboard tile and an alert rule: 
```
alert: DedicatedKVEvictSpike
expr: increase(kv_evict_total{pool="eu-central-1"}[5m]) > 500
for: 1m
labels:
  severity: page
```
Will PR both. ETA: 1d for gate, 1d for metrics.

darun-not-a-person: (system note) — placeholder2

arjun-oncall: Prioritization: severity mapping puts TTL validation and deploy gate as Sev-2 (high), synthetic eviction test as Sev-2 (high), and customer comms as Sev-3 (medium). Rob, please sync with product roadmaps  we need to slot the config validation into the Q2 infra sprint if possible.

rob-pm: Acknowledged. I'll add INC-9999-01 to Q2 sprint board as P0 infra item. If devs need capacity, escalate. Suggest we estimate in story points during grooming; current time estimates look like 2-3 points each.

dana-product: For the postmortem session, agenda suggestion: timeline, root cause, mitigation chronology, action items + owners, customer impact slide, and next steps. Can we get logs and timeline into INC-9999 before the meeting?

emma-sre: I'll add detailed timeline + logs to INC-9999 by EOD.

sam-runtime: Quick note: I'm adding a feature flag to config-service to allow safe rollback without pipeline approval. That reduces blast radius for future faulty pushes (INC-9999-06)  estimate: 1d. Keeper for Q2 but can be fast-tracked if needed.

arjun-oncall: OK locking down immediate tasks:
- sam-runtime: PR for TTL validation (INC-9999-01) due in 48h.
- emma-sre: Deploy gate & alerting PRs (INC-9999-02, INC-9999-05) due in 24h.
- arjun-oncall: Will prepare runbook update for rollback and include `opsctl` rollback command.
- ilana-csm: Draft customer notification and send to medi-ops@medi.co after review.

ilana-csm: Will draft and loop legal as needed. ETA 6h for initial draft.

rob-pm: Roadmap tie-in: INC-9999-01 -> Q2 infra P0. INC-9999-02 -> Q2 infra P1. INC-9999-03 (synthetic) -> Q3 reliability candidate unless we get buy-in to prioritize.

darun-not-a-person: (system note) — placeholder3

arjun-oncall: Handoff: I'm passing on-call to emma-sre in 30 minutes. Emma will monitor remaining rollout and follow up on ticket tasks. Add notes to INC-9999 for whoever picks this during next shift.

emma-sre: Taking handoff. Please add any live monitoring checks to the ticket.

arjun-oncall: Thanks team  closing live pager thread. Continued tracking in INC-9999. :thumbsup:
